+++ b/src/click/strict_text_stream.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from ._compat import _NonClosingTextIOWrapper
+from ._compat import get_best_encoding
+
+
+def strict_text_stream(
+    stream: t.BinaryIO,
+    encoding: str | None,
+    errors: str | None,
+    force_readable: bool = False,
+    force_writable: bool = False,
+) -> t.TextIO:
+    """Wrap a binary stream in a text stream like ``_make_text_stream``,
+    but default ``errors`` to ``"strict"`` so invalid data raises
+    instead of being replaced.
+    """
+    if encoding is None:
+        encoding = get_best_encoding(stream)
+    if errors is None:
+        errors = "strict"
+    return _NonClosingTextIOWrapper(
+        stream,
+        encoding,
+        errors,
+        line_buffering=True,
+        force_readable=force_readable,
+        force_writable=force_writable,
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_strict_text_stream.py b/tests/test_strict_text_stream.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5d63d02
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_strict_text_stream.py
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+import io
+
+import pytest
+
+from click.strict_text_stream import strict_text_stream
+
+
+def test_invalid_bytes_raise_by_default():
+    stream = strict_text_stream(io.BytesIO(b"\xff"), "utf-8", None)
+    with pytest.raises(UnicodeDecodeError):
+        stream.read()
+
+
+def test_explicit_errors_respected():
+    stream = strict_text_stream(io.BytesIO(b"a\xffb"), "utf-8", "replace")
+    assert stream.read() == "a\ufffdb"
+
+
+def test_empty_input():
+    stream = strict_text_stream(io.BytesIO(b""), None, None)
+    assert stream.read() == ""
+    assert stream.errors == "strict"
+
+
+def test_does_not_close_underlying_stream():
+    raw = io.BytesIO(b"abc")
+    stream = strict_text_stream(raw, "utf-8", None)
+    assert stream.read() == "abc"
+    del stream
+    assert not raw.closed
